audience.text: Python developers building applications that require generating Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, and QR Code barcodes without system-level dependencies beyond Pillow.

capabilities.text: Supports Code 128 (with automatic or forced encode mode), Code 39 (base and extended), EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, and QR Code (Model 2).
capabilities.title: Generate multiple barcode symbologies

capabilities.text: Produce SVG via `to_svg()` or `SvgRenderer`, and PNG via `to_png()` or `PngRenderer`, with optional rendering options.
capabilities.title: Render barcodes to SVG and PNG

capabilities.text: Control scale, DPI, module width/height, quiet zone, colors, transparent background, and text display via `RenderOptions`.
capabilities.title: Configure rendering options

capabilities.text: Set encode mode, error correction level, check digit behavior, and other symbology-specific parameters through dedicated options types.
capabilities.title: Customize symbology-specific options

capabilities.text: Raise typed exceptions such as `BarcodeError`, `EncodingError`, `RenderingError`, and `InvalidInputError` for robust error handling.
capabilities.title: Handle errors explicitly

limitations.text: PDF rendering is not implemented; `Barcode.to_pdf()` and `PdfRenderer.render()` raise `NotImplementedError`.
ECI normalization and validation are not implemented despite `EncodeOptions` exposing an `eci_assignment_number` field.
GS1 data parsing and validation are not implemented despite `EncodeOptions` exposing a `gs1_enabled` field.
The library only generates barcodes and does not decode or read existing barcode images.

problems_solved.text: Provides a pure-Python, dependency-light way to generate multiple barcode symbologies with deterministic output.
Enables flexible rendering to SVG and PNG formats with configurable options like scale, DPI, module width, and text display.
Supports both dedicated helper functions and a generic `generate()` entry point for selecting symbologies by name.
Offers structured error handling through dedicated exception types for encoding and rendering failures.

product_summary.text: Aspose.BarCode FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, open-source library for generating deterministic, standards-compliant linear and 2D barcodes.

workflows.name: Generate and render a Code 128 barcode
workflows.text: Call `code128()` with payload data, then invoke `to_svg()` or `to_png()` to produce output.

workflows.name: Generate a QR Code with custom options
workflows.text: Use `qr()` with payload and `QrOptions` specifying error correction level and encoding mode, then render to PNG or SVG.

workflows.name: Render with custom options
workflows.text: Pass `RenderOptions` to `to_svg()` or `to_png()` to control scale, DPI, module width, text display, and colors.

workflows.name: Render using a specific renderer
workflows.text: Instantiate a `Renderer` subclass such as `SvgRenderer`, pass it to `Barcode.render()` with `RenderOptions`, and extract rendered data.

workflows.name: Select symbology generically
workflows.text: Call `generate()` with a symbology name and payload to produce a `Barcode` instance for any supported type.

workflows.name: Add check digit to Code 39
workflows.text: Call `code39()` with `Code39Options` and `add_check_digit=True` to include a modulo-43 check character.
